description: PAT-11 and PAT-16, deciding variants: counted U+0000 in subject and pattern, and pattern reuse after the parameter changes, with no Requery. Nul holds S = 'A', 'A'+NUL, 'A'+NUL+'B', 'A'+NUL+'C'. Asks, for pattern values 'A', 'A'+NUL, 'A'+NUL+'B', 'A'+NUL+'C', 'A'+NUL+'*' (each on a fresh temporary QueryDef PARAMETERS pp Text(255): Len(S), S = pp and S LIKE pp per row); then one QueryDef whose pp is assigned 'A'+NUL+'B', then 'A'+NUL+'C', then 'A' with a newly opened recordset after each assignment. Follow-up probe (status F) for PAT-11, PAT-16, EXPR-BIND; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
